shared_elements: large upright monolithic body treated as a figure
head or block element surmounting the body
low-relief shallow carving covering the torso/front face
vertical elongated motifs running down the body
linear incised/relief bands and repeated motifs
justification: Both depict an abstracted upright monolithic body crowned by a blocky head-like element, with shallow low-relief motifs confined to the torso surface and elongated vertical elements descending the front — a fairly specific convention of turning a standing stone into a body carrying its ornament in relief. However, the actual motifs differ substantially: A shows rings, discs, curvilinear loops and a horizontal belt-like band with pendant forms, while B shows repeated chevron/herringbone columns within a plain recessed panel, with no discs or belt.
